requirements.title: An OPTIONAL statement permits a double colon and requires a dummy-name list
requirements.definition: OPTIONAL is followed by an optional double colon and a nonempty comma-separated list of dummy argument names. R401 supplies the list and explicit R1534 the name production, overriding assumed R402. No inline array/coarray specification, component designator or invocation is part of that list. The statement supplies the existing OPTIONAL attribute, subject to actual dummy role, uniqueness, interface and other declaration conditions.

pending.double-colon-form: PENDING compile/positive-control: a complete subroutine with a named ordinary INTEGER dummy b and one OPTIONAL :: b statement. No OPTIONAL type attribute, initialization, body read or call is added. A definition's own interface is explicit; any future external call needs the required interface.
pending.no-double-colon-form: PENDING the same complete source with OPTIONAL b. Both colons are omitted together, not replaced by one colon; the actual dummy and declaration remain valid.
pending.multiple-data-and-procedure-dummies: PENDING complete module/abstract-interface/subroutine controls naming two distinct data dummies and an ordinary nonpointer PROCEDURE(signature) dummy in one list. Every name occurs in the header and is specified OPTIONAL once. Do not add POINTER merely because INTENT has a different procedure rule, and do not invoke an absent callback.
pending.missing-list-exclusion: PENDING complete OPTIONAL and OPTIONAL :: empty-list negatives, each repaired by inserting an existing valid dummy name with required token separation. The correct surrounding subroutine and END statement stay unchanged. Require a causal missing-list report, not generic EOF or an unknown-name message.
pending.list-separator-repair: PENDING two existing eligible dummy names with one missing comma or a trailing comma, separately repaired by adding or removing that comma. Do not repeat a dummy name and turn C815 into a grammar oracle.
pending.name-not-declarator-or-designator: PENDING an ordinary array dummy whose shape is declared separately and an OPTIONAL :: a(:) statement, repaired only to OPTIONAL :: a. The whole eligible dummy remains. Component/function-reference contrasts need their own complete role-valid repairs; deleting a suffix from a nondummy object does not suffice.

pending.single-specification-source: PENDING C815/8.5.1 source relations for one explicit statement versus a type/procedure OPTIONAL attribute plus a second statement. The duplicate-attribute predicate is not R853 list syntax. Chosen prior explicit types are not a universal ordering rule.

Unsupported procedures, wrong dummy role, duplicate attributes, absent interfaces, unrelated type/state errors, quoted/source echoes and compiler failures do not corroborate a grammar case. No omission, PRESENT, forwarding, allocation or association effect is credited.
